,abc.EstimatedWeight ,abc.WeightDifference ,abc.StockTransactionId ,abc.NetWeight, abc.GatePassNo, abc.GrossWeight -- ,Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionId -- ,INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID -- ,Inv_Doc.DocumentType ,INV_SecondWeight.SecondWeightID ,SAL_GateIn.CustomerName as GateInCustomer ,SAL_VehicleCancellation.DocumentNo as CancelDocNo ,SAL_VehicleCancellation.Remarks as CancelRemarks from SAL_GateIn

left JOin INV_FirstWeight on INV_FirstWeight.GateINID = SAL_GateIn.GateInNo AND INV_FirstWeight.GateInDocType = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID AND INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID = SAL_GateIn.CompanyID AND INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID = SAL_GateIn.PeriodID AND INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID = SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID AND INV_FirstWeight.Status = 1
left Join INV_LoadingPointHeader on INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocNo = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentNo AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.TareWtDocTypeID = INV_FirstWeight.DocumentTypeID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID = INV_FirstWeight.CompanyID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodID = INV_FirstWeight.PeriodID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID = INV_FirstWeight.CurrentFiscalID AND INV_LoadingPointHeader.Status = 1
left Join INV_SecondWeight on INV_SecondWeight.LoadingPointNo = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentNo AND INV_SecondWeight.LPDocType = INV_LoadingPointHeader.DocumentTypeID AND INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CompanyID AND INV_SecondWeight.PeriodId = INV_LoadingPointHeader.PeriodId AND INV_SecondWeight.CurrentFiscalID = INV_LoadingPointHeader.CurrentFiscalID AND INV_SecondWeight.Status = 1
left join SAL_VehicleCancellation on SAL_VehicleCancellation.DocumentNo = SAL_GateIn.GateInNo and SAL_VehicleCancellation.DocumentTypeID = SAL_GateIn.DocumentTypeID and SAL_VehicleCancellation.CompanyID= SAL_GateIn.CompanyID and SAL_VehicleCancellation.PeriodID= SAL_GateIn.PeriodID and SAL_VehicleCancellation.FiscalID= SAL_GateIn.CurrentFiscalID
--Left Join INV_StockTransactionHeader on INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID = INV_SecondWeight.SecondWeightID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID = INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID = INV_SecondWeight.PeriodID --AND INV_StockTransactionHeader.Status = 1 --left JOIN SET_DocumentType Inv_Doc ON Inv_Doc.COMPANYID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID --AND Inv_Doc.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID
-- left Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo --AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID --AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID --AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID --AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1
--left Join Ar_Set_Customer dispatchcust on dispatchcust.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID --AND dispatchcust.Status = 1

left join INV_ITem on INV_Item.ItemID = INV_StockTransactionDetail.ItemID left Join SAL_DispatchHeader on SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentNo AND SAL_DispatchHeader.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.CompanyID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.PeriodID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.FiscalID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.FiscalID AND SAL_DispatchHeader.Status = 1 left Join Ar_Set_Customer dispatchcust on dispatchcust.CustomerID = SAL_DispatchHeader.CustomerID AND dispatchcust.Status = 1 left JOIN SET_DocumentType Inv_Doc ON Inv_Doc.COMPANYID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID AND Inv_Doc.DocumentTypeID = INV_StockTransactionHeader.DocumentTypeID AND Inv_Doc.Status = 1
group by INV_StockTransactionHeader.CompanyID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.PeriodID,INV_StockTransactionHeader.GrossWeightID,Inv_StockTransactionHeader.StockTransactionID ,INV_ITem.UnitVolume,SAL_DispatchHeader.NetWeight,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchNo,SAL_DispatchHeader.DispatchDate,dispatchcust.CustomerName,SAL_DispatchHeader.GatePassNo ,SAL_DispatchHeader.GrossWeight,DocumentType,SAl_DispatchHeader.CreateDate ) abc on abc.CompanyID = INV_SecondWeight.CompanyID and abc.PeriodID = INV_SecondWeight.PeriodID and abc.GrossWeightID = INV_SecondWeight.DocumentNo and abc.NameType = Lower(RTRIM(LTRIM(SUBSTRING(DocumentType,CHARINDEX('-',DocumentType)+1,LEN(DocumentType)))))
